capabilities: Export a note with all transclusions recursively expanded into a new Markdown file
Inline a single transclusion under the cursor, adding an HTML comment source marker
Configure export presets such as strip block IDs, strip comments, keep frontmatter, and nest headings
Report missing or circular embeds as blockquotes in the output
Integrate with Inkling Markup to copy the original text of notes under review
extras: Desktop only; installed as a beta plugin via BRAT. Missing or circular embeds become blockquotes and are counted in the completion notice; wikilinks and image/PDF embeds are left unchanged.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to flatten a note composed of transclusions into one self-contained file, or to replace a single embed with a copy of its text for separate editing.
summary: Desktop-only plugin that exports notes assembled from ![[...]] embeds with every transclusion recursively expanded, and inlines single embeds for editing.
